name: Chile
summary: Linear Pacific Andean nation with diverse bioclimatic zones from the hyper-arid Atacama Desert to Patagonian fjords. World-class solar irradiance in the north complements expanding utility wind and storage along the central grid.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 4.24x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Santiago mountain basin and southern residential wood combustion create winter particulate spikes.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; central Chile megadrought now extending into second continuous decade.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming trend across Andean and coastal stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.2% share of global emissions; active coal phaseout agreements retiring thermal units.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below G20 average; clean grid transition accelerating electrification of copper mining.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Valdivian temperate rainforests and southern Patagonian beech cover ~181,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Clean transition leader: solar (19.8%), hydropower (25.1%), and onshore wind (11.8%) drive national grid.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 26 people/km²; urban population fraction is 87.8%.
